damage_modifiers: Shift one column right if aircraft already L or more damaged.
Shift one column left if hit was from gun snap shot.
-2 to die roll if air to air rocket hit or direct hit from missile.
Plus or Minus Aircraft Vulnerability as listed on target ADC.

air_to_air_rocketry_table.note: above = die roll to hit numbers

rocketry_modifiers: If C.C. Rocket Attack Technology in effect, apply a -2 modifier to the hit roll.
All other gun and rocket attack modifiers apply as well.
page1.cc_rocket_attack_procedure: Target must be locked-on by radar, and firer may only use TT or less turns, altitude changes of no more than 1 level, and no maneuvers except slides up to the point of firing.

aircraft_damage_effects.L: Light Damage; no ET turns allowed, lose High Pitch Rate, aircraft becomes Low Roll Rate.
aircraft_damage_effects.2L: Light Damage; as L plus no BT turns allowed, +1 to all preparatory move requirements.
aircraft_damage_effects.H: Heavy Damage; as 2L plus Mil and A/B power halved, CCC halved, no roll maneuvers allowed, no supersonic flight allowed. Roll once for Systems Loss.
aircraft_damage_effects.C: Crippled; as H plus lose A/B power, no HT turns, A/C smokes, lose all technology. Roll for again Systems loss.
aircraft_damage_effects.K: Aircraft Killed (shot down), remove from play.
aircraft_damage_effects.note: If end speed > High Transonic when "H" or "C" damaged, roll twice for prog. damage even if Damage Control done.

systems_loss_table.1: Cockpit: Pilot Killed, remove aircraft from play.
systems_loss_table.2: Cockpit: Crewman Killed. Lose multi-crew bonuses, and lose radar and weapon technology. Bomb system = manual.
systems_loss_table.4_5: Radar disabled. Lose all radar functions.
systems_loss_table.6_7: ECM disabled. Lose all ECM functions.
systems_loss_table.8: Weapons System disabled, aircraft may no longer attack. Jettison stores.
systems_loss_table.9: Internal guns and any gunpods disabled.

ir_missiles: +2 for each Turn Rate over Launch Gee.
+2 If fired from LO or ML alt. band at lower target.
+3 If fired into sun clutter; if fired out-of-envelope.
+3 If fired at lower target above highest cloud layer.
+ lesser of Flare PPL or missile Flare Vulnerability number if DDS program in effect.
br_rh_and_ah_missiles: +2 for each Turn Rate over Launch Gee.
+3 If Snap Fired; if fired out-of-envelope.

ir_sams: + lesser of Flare PPL or missile Flare Vulnerability number if DDS program in effect.

irms_and_ir_sams: +2 If missile must lose 2 or more levels during proportional move of attack against tgt. in LO alt. band (ground clutter).
+1 If target in Terrain Following Flight.
+ lesser of Flare PPL or missile Flare Vulnerability no.
brms_rhms_ahms_and_br_cg_cw_and_tvm_sams: + lesser of Chaff PPL or missile Chaff Vulnerability.
+ lesser of Mini-jammer PPL or Chaff Vulnerability +1.
+ Ground clutter (air to air missiles only) = 6 – target Altitude above terrain – missile ECCM.
+ Listed "T" level modifier (SAMs only, if applicable).
air_to_air_and_sam_missile_attack_modifi.og_and_lg_sams: No modifiers other than angle-off and A/C size apply.
all_missiles: +/- Target A/C Size Modifier from ADC.
-1 if Target A/C did not Engage the missile.
air_to_air_and_sam_missile_attack_modifi.reminder: Max launch range of RHM/AHM = 3 x radar Track Str.#.

aaa_unit_attack_modifiers: +2 If integral FCR jammed or not used.
-2 If FCR-B or C unit in use.

jinking_versus_aaa.short: BT Turns, Snap-Turns, or Rolls or VIFF Maneuvers.

die_roll_to_evade_hit.note: Apply Aircraft Size Modifier from ADC to this die roll.

plotted_fire_procedure: Target A/C is one nearest Heavy AAA unit.
Roll one die referencing Random Plotted Fire Diagram.
Roll Die Twice; Subtract 2d roll from first for Altitude difference in levels from Target Altitude.

final_attack_strength_computations.individual_weapons: ALL – Use listed Strength versus Hard / Soft Target.

multiple_weapons.guns: Sum of Attack Ratings of all guns & GPs fired.

versus_secondary_targets.all_others: 1/3 FAS used on Primary Target (Note: make adjustments for Hard / Soft targets).

air_to_ground_attack_die_roll_modifiers.fire_or_napalm_type_weapons: +1 for each Level above 1 over tgt. at release
air_to_ground_attack_die_roll_modifiers.toss_bombing: +1 per hex of distance, +2 per hex if target unsighted.
air_to_ground_attack_die_roll_modifiers.laser_toss_bombing: +1 per two hexes distance, +1 per hex if target unsighted.
air_to_ground_attack_die_roll_modifiers.arm_and_asm_weapons: use only Terrain modifiers when attacking.
